title: Интервью со звездой
description: Проиграй по ролям интервью журналиста со звездой: распорядок дня, тренировки и свободное время. Реплики появляются на экране по очереди.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: Hi! Thanks for the interview. Do you wake up early?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: No, I don't. I usually wake up at 10 AM because I work late at night.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: What do you eat for breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: I usually eat eggs and toast, and I drink a lot of coffee.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: How often do you train?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: I train five times a week because I want to stay fit.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: Do you play any musical instrument?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: Yes, I do. I play the guitar and I write my own songs.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: Who helps you with your work?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: My manager helps me and my girlfriend edits my videos.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: Do you go to parties?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: Sometimes I do, but I don't like big crowds of people.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: What do you do in your free time?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: I read detective novels and I take my dog for a walk twice a day.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: Do you have a pet?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: Yes, I have a dog. He chews my shoes but I love him.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: Do you travel a lot?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: Yes, I do. I fly to different countries every month.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: How do you feel before a concert?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: I always feel nervous, but when I start to play I feel great.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: Do you read reviews about yourself?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: No, I don't. I don't trust strangers on the Internet.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: What do you dream about?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: I dream of becoming famous all over the world.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: Where do you live now?

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: I live in a big house near the sea with my family.

dialogue.speaker: journalist
dialogue.text: Thanks for the interview and good luck!

dialogue.speaker: star
dialogue.text: You're welcome. See you soon!
